title: AntiPatternSpecification
description: Schema enforcing the required three-part anatomy of a critical project-specific anti-pattern: Violation, Consequence, and Mitigation.

id.description: Sequential index of the anti-pattern (1 through 12).

title.description: Descriptive, domain-specific name of the prohibited pattern.

domain.description: System domain affected by the anti-pattern.

severity.description: Severity classification. Must be CRITICAL or HIGH.

violation.description: Exact description of the prohibited code construct, bad practice, or protocol deviation.

consequence.description: Direct, concrete failure mode, security breach, rate-limit ban, or data corruption resulting from the violation.

mitigation.description: Mandatory architectural rule, code pattern, or automated gate required to prevent the violation.
